passed_checks.check_name: Ensure no hard-coded secrets exist in EC2 user data
code_block:
resource "aws_instance" "frappe_crm" {
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux_2023.id
  instance_type               = var.instance_type
  key_name                    = aws_key_pair.frappe_key.key_name
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.frappe_sg.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  credit_specification {
    cpu_credits = "standard"
  }

  root_block_device {
    volume_size           = var.root_volume_size
    volume_type           = "gp3"
    delete_on_termination = true
    tags = {
      Name = "frappe-crm-root-volume"
    }
  }

  # Bootstrapping (User Data) Cloud-Init Script
  user_data = <<-EOF
              #!/bin/bash
              set -euxo pipefail

              # 1. Allocate 4GB Swap Space (ensures 1GB Free-Tier instances meet 4GB RAM requirement)
              if [ ! -f /swapfile ]; then
                  dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=4096
                  chmod 600 /swapfile
                  mkswap /swapfile
                  swapon /swapfile
                  echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
                  sysctl vm.swappiness=60
              fi

              # 2. Update system
              dnf update -y

              # 3. Install Docker and git
              dnf install -y docker git

              # 4. Start and enable Docker service
              systemctl enable --now docker

              # 5. Add ec2-user to docker group
              usermod -aG docker ec2-user

              # 6. Install Docker Compose CLI plugin
              DOCKER_CLI_PLUGINS="/usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins"
              mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CLI_PLUGINS"
              curl -SL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" -o "$DOCKER_CLI_PLUGINS/docker-compose"
              chmod +x "$DOCKER_CLI_PLUGINS/docker-compose"
              ln -sf "$DOCKER_CLI_PLUGINS/docker-compose" /usr/local/bin/docker-compose

              echo "Docker and Swap bootstrap finished successfully"
              EOF

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. APPLICATION DEPLOYMENT (File Provisioners & Remote Execution)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  connection {
    type        = "ssh"
    user        = "ec2-user"
    private_key = file(pathexpand(var.private_key_path))
    host        = self.public_ip
    timeout     = "5m"
  }

  # Transfer local docker-compose.yml from workspace root to EC2 instance
  provisioner "file" {
    source      = "${path.module}/../docker-compose.yml"
    destination = "/home/ec2-user/docker-compose.yml"
  }

  # Transfer init.sh required by Frappe CRM container
  provisioner "file" {
    source      = "${path.module}/../init.sh"
    destination = "/home/ec2-user/init.sh"
  }

  # Transfer local .env file from workspace root to EC2 instance
  provisioner "file" {
    source      = "${path.module}/../.env"
    destination = "/home/ec2-user/.env"
  }

  # Remote execution to start Frappe CRM
  provisioner "remote-exec" {
    inline = [
      "echo '==> Waiting for cloud-init (user_data) to complete installation...'",
      "cloud-init status --wait",
      "echo '==> Fixing line endings and permissions on init.sh...'",
      "cd /home/ec2-user",
      "sed -i 's/\\r$//' init.sh",
      "chmod +x init.sh",
      "echo '==> Launching Frappe CRM via docker compose...'",
      "docker compose up -d || sudo docker compose up -d",
      "echo '==> Containers launched successfully!'"
    ]
  }

  tags = {
    Name        = "frappe-crm-instance"
    Environment = "devops-internship"
    Project     = "Frappe-CRM"
  }
}
